title: Navy High-Speed Wi-Fi Reaches Milestone for Global Unaccompanied Housing
summary: The Navy's initiative to provide free, high-speed Wi-Fi to all Navy unaccompanied housing is 90% complete, with the service now available in 865 of 962 buildings since the rollout began in November 2025.
author: Commander, Navy Installations Command Headquarters Public Affairs
title_norm: navy high speed wi fi reaches milestone for global unaccompanied housing
